title: Hom complex from the structure sheaf is the identity
statement: Let C be a small category, J a Grothendieck topology on C, and R a sheaf of commutative rings on (C,J). In the category of sheaves of R-modules [def-pur-sheaf-hom], let O denote the unit sheaf. The Hom-complex bifunctor [def-pur-hom-complex] evaluated in its first argument at O concentrated in degree zero is naturally isomorphic to the identity on unbounded cochain complexes indexed by the integers. All category, coefficient, and module universes may be the same universe u.

proof.text: For L = O[0], the degree-n product in homComplex_exists has factors Hom(L^p,M^(p+n)). For p nonzero, L^p is zero and its internal Hom is zero. Projection to p=0 is therefore an isomorphism to Hom(O,M^n). Evaluation at one, whose inverse is x mapped to (r mapped to r*x), gives an isomorphism to M^n. These maps respect restrictions because the structure sheaf restrictions preserve one.

The differential formula in homComplex_exists reduces to postcomposition with d_M: the precomposition term vanishes since the single complex has zero differential. Evaluation at one commutes with postcomposition, proving that the degreewise isomorphisms are a chain isomorphism. The componentwise map formula for homComplex_exists proves naturality for every chain map. The zero complex, empty site, zero ring, and arbitrary shifts cause no exception: each construction is degreewise and only the source is concentrated in degree zero.
